name: Bippen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bippen (white oak leaves on blue above a white megalithic tomb on green).
history: The arms, designed by Hans Heinrich Reclam, were granted by the Regierungspräsident in Osnabrück in 1976.

features.role: Bippen arms — oak leaves and megalithic tomb
